note: Live JP shop that lists 巻ノ singles one product per card, with the printed ref and the Japanese name in the title (忍-165 パックン, 忍-190 聖シモン, 忍-194 猿飛アスマ…) and a shop photo. 39 card entries carried a 忍/術/作/依/騎 ref on the 2026-08-19 capture of page 1; the rest of the product blocks on that HTML are the site-wide sidebar, not this category. Page encoding is EUC-JP — decode before parsing or every title turns to mojibake. No pagination link was emitted for csid=24. Ingesteur livré le 2026-08-19 (`scrapeAvalonShop.ts`, étape `scrape` du CLI) : une seule page de catégorie, jamais un crawl de la boutique. Première passe : 39 faces écrites, dont 8 sur des cartes qui n'avaient aucune image.

imageUrl.note: Shop photo, not a scan — last-resort face only, below nikita / carddas / suruga in faceChoice. Titles carry condition suffixes like （若干傷み）that are not part of the card name.

why: The JA hole is the biggest in the catalogue (705 named prints without a face on 2026-08-19). Every other JA host is exhausted: nikita 392 all installed, carddas.com official dump holds only ~18 card GIFs, Suruga listings installed with 33 CDN 404, Mercari/Yahoo are paste-only. This is the first live shop found that addresses cards by their printed ref.
